title: Create the Stripe account, enable test mode, and place restricted keys and the webhook secret in SSM
description:
Only Ryan can do this. Nothing in the other billing stories waits on it: they build and spec against the fake processor. This task turns the real adapter on.

Steps, all on Ryan's Mac:
1. Create the Anthus Stripe account (business details, bank account for payouts, statement descriptor). Decide the legal entity name and address that appear on invoices (epic open question 7).
2. In test mode, create a restricted API key with only: Customers write, Subscriptions write, Invoices write, Checkout Sessions write, Billing Portal write, Payment Intents read, Prices and Products read, Events read. No full secret key is ever stored.
3. Create the webhook endpoint for the production URL `POST /billing/stripe/webhook` once that route exists, subscribed to: invoice.finalized, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed, invoice.voided, invoice.marked_uncollectible, customer.subscription.created, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted, checkout.session.completed, charge.refunded. Record the signing secret.
4. Put the restricted key and the signing secret in SSM SecureString parameters `/prospectus/billing/stripe/secret-key/v1` and `/prospectus/billing/stripe/webhook-secret/v1` (aws/ssm key), by hand with the AWS CLI, as for the login challenge MAC parameter. Never in the repository, a pipeline variable, an issue or a log.
5. Create the test-mode Products and Prices for the plans in `accounts/billing-plans.json` and record their `price_...` ids in that file (test ids are not secrets). Live-mode prices come later with a separate reviewed change.
6. Approve the IAM additions the billing runtime needs (listed in the epic, decision 10) and set `billing/deployment.json` to `stripe: { enabled: true, mode: "test" }` in a reviewed change.

Done looks like: parameters exist, the catalog has test price ids, the deployment flag is on in test mode, and a labelled test-mode Checkout session completes end to end against a test account with a made-up client.

Nothing here handles real money until a later, separate decision switches `mode` to `live`.
